name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's motorsport journey began in the bustling workshops of his uncle's automotive repair shop in Yokohama. Immersed in the world of engines and precision engineering from a young age, he developed a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of vehicle mechanics. After graduating with an engineering degree, Kenji joined a small racing team as a junior mechanic, quickly rising through the ranks thanks to his meticulous approach and unwavering dedication.

His career took a pivotal turn when he transitioned into team management. Kenji's ability to blend technical expertise with effective communication and team leadership skills made him a natural fit for the sporting director role. He thrives on optimizing team performance through data-driven decision-making and fostering a collaborative environment where innovation can flourish. Kenji's calm demeanor under pressure and his knack for finding creative solutions to complex challenges set him apart, making him a valuable asset to Proton by Premotion.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Kenji has a wiry build and a focused gaze that reflects his analytical mind.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when deep in thought.
Prefers to drink green tea throughout the day, claiming it enhances his focus.
